items.root_cause_at_head: packages/runtime/src/session/budget-pause.ts:76-83: NOTHING accepts a 'nothing' followed only by left/required words, by an ABOUT clause that must start with a preposition (for, in, by, under, within, to meet ...; :76) or by punctuation and a reason (:78); 'nothing [that] the criteria require' has neither, so isNothing (:92) is false and parseHandoff keeps it as an item (:176-207). packages/runtime/src/session/executor.ts:1725-1732 then pauses (wrap-up sent and leftToDo not empty). The words the model hears invite the qualifier: WRAP_UP_BRIEF_LINE (budget-pause.ts:52-53: "'Left to do:' (only what the task's criteria still need ..., or 'nothing'; ...)") and wrapUpText (packages/runtime/src/agent/loop.ts:106-110: 'Left to do: (only what the task's criteria still need, as a list with the next step first, or nothing; ...)').
items.fix_sketch: (1) budget-pause.ts: a relative-clause form after the left/required group, (?:\s+(?:that|which))?\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:task'?s\s+)?(?:(?:acceptance|two|three|\d+)\s+)?(?:criteri(?:a|on)|brief|task|scope|requirements?|deliverables?)(?:\s+(?:still|yet))?\s+(?:requires?|needs?|asks?\s+for|calls?\s+for|demands?), with ABOUT's reason tail; and the general rule that ends the one-phrasing-at-a-time patching (this is the third live phrasing after W15-14 and L3-research-1): a Left-to-do line that starts with nothing/none, names the whole set (WHOLE_SET) and has no NOT_NOTHING word is nothing. ONE_CRITERION and NOT_NOTHING stay ('nothing the criteria require yet: the tests fail' stays an item; 'nothing criterion 2 needs' says nothing of the rest). (2) Model-facing words, exact text on both drivers: WRAP_UP_BRIEF_LINE and wrapUpText ask for the single word 'nothing' as the whole list when the criteria are met; WRAP_UP_MARK, the trigger, the line, the reserve and the save-only rule unchanged. (3) ADR 0112's parse paragraph (dated amendment) and docs/maintainers/runtime.md's budget-pause section.
items.test_boundary: Composed runtime (packages/runtime/test/budget-pause.test.ts, beside the case 'a run that hears the wrap-up and lists only Nothing for the acceptance criteria ... is reviewed and done'): the stand-in researcher's post-wrap-up reply is LC-C7's seq 8 report word for word; expect the task reviewed and done in the same session, run outcomes ['completed'], no 'paused before' or 'listed one thing left to do' line in GET /sessions/:id/events, and no card for it in GET /inbox (today: the Continue card). parseHandoff unit cases for the live line and its siblings. Exact-text assertions of the brief line in the composed model-call log, of the wrap-up block at the request the fake provider receives (wrap-up.test.ts) and at PostToolUse's additionalContext (sdk-driver.test.ts).
items.notes: Not model_only: the app's own wrap-up words ask for 'only what the criteria still need ... or nothing', which invites a qualifier, and ADR 0112 says a 'nothing' about the criteria is nothing. Money: the person was asked for CHF 0.40 more, and the second session ran a researcher run (about CHF 0.03) that changed nothing. LC-C7's other problems are L4-money-102 (the tagline task did not run) and L4-money-104 (the Details count); merged here because LC-C7 was 'partial' for this cause first.

items.root_cause_at_head: packages/runtime/src/session/runner.ts:3544-3558: every paused result whose source stopEndsSession(...) ends the session, skips the queue and sets stopReason; packages/runtime/src/session/budget-pause.ts:241-243 counts source 'session' as ending it. Never 'used the rest of this one', 'The session's budget is used' or 'Stopped: the budget is used' while the spent figure is under the work budget; the stop sentence follows the real reason. Update the plan wording beside runner.ts:~5335 and oversize-words.ts; change oversized-task.test.ts:362-369 and :391-393 to assert on the room left, keeping their intent (named in tests_changed_for_design). The session cap, the review reserve and the wrap-up line stay; nothing passes the work budget.

items.fix_sketch: In LoopTaskExecutor.execute read what the outer limits still allow this run's scope (the project's budget, the month's cap; the plan share's room only through the caps port) with the level that binds, at the stop line (not the 80% room): e.g. an append-only CapsPort.remainingUsdMicro(scope) -> {usdMicro, level}. brief.budgetUsdMicro = min(work cap, session left, that remainder); runCapSource 'project' or 'month' when it binds; the token, the wrap-up line, the reserve and the stop sentence then follow one figure. When the remainder binds, keep room in it for the task's review as BA-4 does inside a task's budget (R + W when it can hold it; else the review pauses as today). budgetLineWords names the limit ('This run may spend CHF 0.06, what is left of the project's budget: ...'). The hooks' caps.check stays the backstop. Fake daemon, ADR 0112 points 4 and 7 (dated amendment), runtime.md.

items.notes: Raised to major (the verdict said minor): the owner's D4 ('wrap up in an organized and error free way such that the work can be continued') holds today only under the task's and the session's budgets; under a project budget or the month's cap the run gets a hard stop, and the start line's money figure is wrong. Decided without an owner question: keeping review room inside a binding outer limit is BA-4's rule applied to the limit that binds (the owner's answer of 2026-11-16 counts the reviews in what a task costs). The share's stop and its words stay l4-cred-engine's.
